subject: [PATCH v4 09/21] ext4: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for ext4 to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated using the DEFINE_IOMAP_ITER_NEXT() macro. This change does not introduce any functional changes and only updates the code structure. The patch affects two files: fs/ext4/extents.c and fs/ext4/inode.c, making a total of 9 insertions and 3 deletions.
